index: Consumer Price Index, all items (2016 rebase, fourth quarter of 2016 = 100), American Samoa Department of Commerce, Statistics Division
note: Quarterly: each year's mean is of its four quarters. 2021's are read from the Department of Commerce's American Samoa Statistical Yearbook 2023-2024 (published May 2026), Table 11.1, which gives each year's quarters from the fourth to the first, all items in the first column of figures: 2021's fourth 113.7, third 108.9, second 107.0, first 105.2 (each agrees with the table's annual inflation against 2020's quarters: 9.7, 5.1, 3.3 and 1.4 per cent). They revise the Department's Q3 2021 newsletter's first and second quarters (105.1 and 106.9) by a tenth. 2025's quarters are the Department's as the Pacific Community's Pacific Data Hub carries them (DF_CPI), the Department's own folders not opening from here; the Hub's 2022 to 2024 quarters are the yearbook's (2022: 117.4, 119.7, 123.6, 124.7; 2024: 125.6, 127.5, 126.5, 128.0; 2023's second quarter 125.6 against the yearbook's 125.5), so the two are one series on the 2016 rebase.
